question: Can raw six-bit actual-do intervention evidence be losslessly projected into existing unmodified NKR04 four-bit context + binary action native checkpoint only when the single discarded intervention bit is experimentally demonstrated invariant, preserving exact identity/cold state, and safely rejecting unsound projections?

design.input: Exact-pin, canonical ASCII source-free engineering JSON with 64 unique 6-bit observed-do (mask,effect,source_ref) rows, all masks 0..63, fixed native slot 0..15, fixed explicit distinct action_bit and nuisance_bit 0..5. Never infer bit roles from truth/held labels.
design.source_mode: engineering_fixture_only, observed_public_intervention, synthetic-fixture only; no real owner source claims or knowledge graph facts
design.observed_validation: Input must be exactly every 6-bit mask once with valid binary effect and unique ASCII source refs; reject incomplete, repeated, unknown provenance, noncanonical, source pin mismatch, malformed types and changed mode before any state creation.
design.context: Four surviving bit positions in ascending order, extracted without collisions. The action bit retains its raw do value. For every (context, action) the two witnessed nuisance=0/1 outcomes MUST be identical or reject the entire bundle atomically.
design.output: Exactly 32 distinct original-NKR04 typed [slot,context,action,effect,aggregate_trace] rows; aggregate trace pins both original records with SHA256; provenance receipt includes original 64-source digest, typed output digest, slot/bit map and witness counts; stage through existing NKR04 stage_native_bundle only, optionally with independently supplied prior_checkpoint; no edits to NKR04/native relation memory or YPC1 checkpoint.
design.decision: Every witnessed native context/action decision must equal an independently implemented direct exact lookup across both observed nuisance values; no model predictions on unobserved outcomes are counted as generalization.
design.bounds: 64 paid witnessed effects per native slot for 32 stored native observations; 16-slot base limit applies; noninjective arbitrary 6->5 mapping is forbidden absent complete nuisance invariance witness; no arbitrary two-bit truncation or inferred source truth
design.authorities: Source-free read-only existing NKR04 and public fixture only, no qualified external source first-use, no original WSP151 source, no main, no merge, no native admission, no scheduler, no accepted runtime, no paid providers

limits: Complete 64-case footprint is exhausted evidence; engineering only, NOT unfamiliar transfer.
Invariance within declared six-bit binary domain does not guarantee invariance under unknown physics, noise, shifted worlds, or temporal causes.
Native aggregate source refs are hashes, not proof an intervention occurred; independent real-source owner qualification is absent.
Compared with independent exact lookup, parity/tie is expected, not evidence of unique neural/intelligence superiority.
Do not modify/retune consumed WSP149-154 synthetic cohorts, WSP151 first-use seeds, NKR04 original fixture or native accepted main.

future_science.require: Independently source-owned virgin prospective worlds, less-than-full observation challenge, matched fully trained conventional and exact symbolic controls, frozen identifiability, noise/contradiction tests, cold retention, CPU/action/memory including 2x evidence overhead and direct native acceptance.
